candidates.title: Open template attribute selection
candidates.statement: The system shall provide open report templates that include attributes associated with circulation, patrons, items, bills, and bibs and allow those attributes to be selected for filtering and for display.
candidates.source_quote: Open template would have all attributes associated with say circulation, patrons, items, bills, and bibs to select from for filtering and the same attributes for displaying

candidates.title: Hover pop-up descriptions
candidates.statement: The system shall display a pop-up description when the user hovers over the title of any canned report or template.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to hover over each title of canned report/template with pop-up box with description

candidates.title: Selectable report fields
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to check off and select any parts or fields of data they want included in a report.
candidates.source_quote: Check off any part of data you want

candidates.title: Report scheduling frequencies
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to schedule reports to run ASAP, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to select Run ASAP, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly

candidates.title: Report output formats
candidates.statement: The system shall provide report output in Excel, HTML, and CSV formats.
candidates.source_quote: Output would be in Excel, HTML, and CSV format

candidates.title: Send reports by email
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to enter email addresses to have generated reports sent to those addresses.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to enter email addresses for report to be sent to

candidates.title: Address book for report recipients
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an address book of regularly used email addresses for selecting report recipients.
candidates.source_quote: would be great to have an address book of regularly used addresses

candidates.title: Edit recurring reports
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to edit recurring reports to add or remove report selections and to edit the email recipient addresses.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to edit recurring reports by adding or removing report selections as well as editing the email addresses

candidates.title: Comparative period columns
candidates.statement: The system shall allow report output to include comparative columns such as last month's circulation, previous month's circulation, previous year's month, and percent-difference columns between periods.
candidates.source_quote: one column for last month's circs, another for previous month's circ, a percent difference column, previous year's month column, a percent difference from last month to last year's month column

candidates.title: Batch conversion status report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report to assist in the batch conversion of item/statuses.
candidates.source_quote: The system provides a report to assist in the batch conversion of statuses

candidates.title: Edit canned report display fields
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to edit canned report display fields, for example adding shelving location to the display.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to edit canned report for display purposes such as adding shelving location as a display

candidates.title: Add canned reports by permission
candidates.statement: The system shall allow additional canned reports to be added and shall control that ability via user permission levels.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to add more canned reports via permission level

candidates.title: Deleted last-copy items list for WorldCat
candidates.statement: The system shall produce a list of items deleted that were the last copy owned by the library system to support updating WorldCat.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to get a list of items deleted that was the last copy owned by the library system in order to update WorldCat

candidates.title: Report prioritization in queue
candidates.statement: The system shall allow certain types of reports to be prioritized so they are moved to the top of the run queue ahead of resource-consuming reports.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to prioritize certain types of reports so they will pop to the top of the queue over resource-consuming reports

candidates.title: Total and date-range use counts
candidates.statement: The system shall provide total use counts on items and shall provide use counts broken down by usage date ranges such as fiscal year or monthly counts.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to have a total use count on items as well as a use count broken down by usage date range such as an FY use count or monthly use count

candidates.title: Total circulation breakdown
candidates.statement: The system shall retrieve total circulation including checkouts, renewals, and noncats and shall display a breakdown by those circulation types.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to retrieve total circ including checkouts, renewals, and noncats with a breakdown displaying those circ types

candidates.title: Upload identifier file for filtering
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to upload a text file (for example barcodes or TCNs) and use the uploaded identifiers to filter report results.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to upload a text file such as barcodes or TCN to use for filtering on a report

candidates.title: Reports for notices sent
candidates.statement: The system shall be able to run reports for pre-overdue notices, overdue notices, and holds notices that were sent.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to run reports for pre-overdue, overdue, and holds notices sent

candidates.title: Pivot table output
candidates.statement: The system shall provide pivot-table style output for reports.
candidates.source_quote: Pivot table output

candidates.title: Tested and proven outputs
candidates.statement: The system shall produce report outputs that are tested and proven to be correct and reliable.
candidates.source_quote: Tested and proven output

candidates.title: Cancel scheduled or running report
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to cancel a report that has been scheduled to run or that is currently running.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to cancel a report that has already been scheduled to run or is currently running

candidates.title: Include nulls and blank fields
candidates.statement: The system shall include all nulls and blank fields in report results regardless of filters or displayed fields.
candidates.source_quote: All nulls and blank fields must be included in the results no matter what is being filtered or displayed

candidates.title: Real-time reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall provide real-time reporting capabilities that reflect current system state.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to have real time reporting

candidates.title: Historical reporting / data warehouse
candidates.statement: The system shall provide historical reporting via a reporting warehouse so data can be acquired for a given date or date range.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to have historical reporting - a reporting warehouse such that data can be acquired on a given date or date range

candidates.title: Selection criteria defined
candidates.statement: The system shall clearly define selection criteria used for reports to ensure users understand what is being selected.
candidates.source_quote: Selection criteria is clearly defined

candidates.title: Include date selection and report name on results
candidates.statement: The system shall include the date selection criteria and the name of the report at the top or bottom of report results.
candidates.source_quote: Report results would include the date selection criteria at the top or bottom ... along with the name of the report

candidates.title: Filter by survey name
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to select a survey by name for filtering reports without entering a survey id.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to select the survey name and not have to enter the survey id for filtering

candidates.title: Report on deleted last-copy items in facility
candidates.statement: The system shall allow running a report on deleted items that were the last copy in a facility.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to run a report on deleted items that were the last copy in the facility

candidates.title: MARC fields on single row
candidates.statement: The system shall be able to pull MARC record fields and present them so that the MARC fields for a bibliographic record appear on a single row of report data.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to pull MARC record fields so that they appear on a single row of data

candidates.title: Filter by transaction date/time, workstation, staff
candidates.statement: The system shall allow reports to be run filtered on transactions that occurred on a specific date and time, on a specific workstation, or by a specific staff member.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to run a report on transactions that occurred on x date and time on x workstation or by x staff
